title: 第115章 驻地自燃下第115章 驻地自燃下
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
四角黑红火光开始变小。
驻地地底的自燃阵，像是承认了这口“炉”。
玄阳宗执事眼神一亮。
“成了？”
周荒却没有放松。
“还差最后一步。”
“它收了炉，就会验炉。”
话音刚落，废药鼎中忽然浮出一只小小眼睛。
那眼睛不是源火残眼，也不是验血眼。
而是一只灰黑色炉眼。
它在鼎里转了一圈，像是在判断这口炉是不是活炉。
众人心里一紧。
如果被它发现是假的，四角火光恐怕会立刻反烧驻地。
周荒忽然伸手，按在鼎口。
沈青禾脸色大变。
“你干什么？”
周荒道：
“给它一点活气。”
“你疯了？”
沈青禾想拦已经来不及。

周荒指尖裂开一线。
一滴血落入废药鼎。
炉眼瞬间盯住那滴血。
可这一次，周荒的血没有像第二炉口那样让它乱判。
因为他只给了一滴。
而且滴在三种炉灰之上。
这滴血不是祭品。
是引子。
炉眼看见活气，终于缓缓闭上。
废药鼎咔的一声，彻底定在雪中。
四角火光同时熄灭。
驻地自燃阵，被骗过去了。
众人还没来得及松口气，雪面上的字却再次变化。
“献炉已收。”
“明夜，献骨。”
“后夜，献魂。”
整个驻地安静得落针可闻。
第一夜要炉。
第二夜要骨。
content_en:
The black and red flames in the four corners began to get smaller.
The spontaneous combustion array under the station seems to recognize this "furnace".
The deacon of Xuanyang Sect’s eyes lit up.
"Done?"
Zhou Huang did not relax.
"There's still one last step left."
"After it collects the furnace, it will examine the furnace."
As soon as he finished speaking, a small eye suddenly appeared in the waste medicine cauldron.
Those eyes are not the source fire remnant eyes, nor are they blood test eyes.
But it is a gray-black furnace eye.
It turned around in the cauldron, as if judging whether the furnace was a living furnace.
Everyone's heart tightened.
If it were found to be fake, the fire in the four corners would immediately burn the station back.
Zhou Huang suddenly stretched out his hand and pressed it on the mouth of the tripod.
Shen Qinghe's expression changed drastically.
"What are you doing?"
Zhou Huang said:
"Give it a little life."
"Are you crazy?"
It was too late for Shen Qinghe to stop him.
Zhou Huang's fingertips were split.
A drop of blood fell into the waste medicine cauldron.
The furnace eyes immediately focused on the drop of blood.
But this time, Zhou Huang's blood did not make him judge randomly like the second furnace.
Because he only gave one drop.
And it drips on three types of ashes.
This drop of blood is not a sacrifice.
It's the introduction.
Seeing the vitality, the furnace eye finally closed slowly.
The waste medicine cauldron clicked and was completely fixed in the snow.
The fires in all four corners went out at the same time.
The resident spontaneous combustion array was deceived.
Before everyone could breathe a sigh of relief, the words on the snow changed again.
"The offering furnace has been collected."
"Tomorrow night, sacrifice the bones."
"The night after tomorrow, offer your soul."
The whole place was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
The first night requires a furnace.
The second night requires bones.
